mapper.update: UPDATE tab_org SET org_path = CONCAT(#{newPrefix}, SUBSTRING(org_path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{oldPrefix}) + 1)), org_parent_path = CASE WHEN LOCATE('/', REVERSE(CONCAT(#{newPrefix}, SUBSTRING(org_path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{oldPrefix}) + 1)))) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE LEFT(CONCAT(#{newPrefix}, SUBSTRING(org_path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{oldPrefix}) + 1)), CHAR_LENGTH(CONCAT(#{newPrefix}, SUBSTRING(org_path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{oldPrefix}) + 1))) - LOCATE('/', REVERSE(CONCAT(#{newPrefix}, SUBSTRING(org_path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{oldPrefix}) + 1))))) END, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE org_path = #{oldPrefix} OR (LEFT(org_path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{oldPrefix})) = #{oldPrefix} AND SUBSTRING(org_path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{oldPrefix}) + 1, 1) = '/')
